skin_notes_from_subagent: NECK POSTURE: every downloaded skin is a straight study skin with the neck fully extended and the head in line with the trunk (bill tip, eye, body axis collinear); this lengthens bill-tip-to-tail-tip to 19.6-23.1 cm versus a live bird with retracted neck, so use body length from skins only for trunk/head/tail segment lengths, not for overall pose. The mounted specimens (Naturalis 155448 etc., Auckland) show the natural retracted perched neck.

TAIL: in several frames the tail is fanned (259388.a dor, 5070087.a dor, EWOC_0396 D/V), so tail_tip is partly estimated. In the lateral frames of 259485.a and 5070087.a the wingtip sits at 0.955 and 0.944 of the bill-to-tail length (tail ~0.9-1.1 cm beyond the wingtip); in 259388.a lat_left and EWOC_0396 LS the wingtip lies slightly beyond the tail tip (1.016, 1.057).

WING BEND/SHOULDER: the carpal bend is not directly visible on folded wings; "wing_front" is the anterior end of the visible covert tract (proxy) and is LOW confidence (+-40-100 px). Lateral estimates: 0.402 (5070087.a), 0.436 (259388.a), 0.397 (EWOC_0396 LS) of the bill-to-tail length from the bill tip.
All px_per_cm values are for the ruler plane; no camera distance is given so the perspective magnification of the body top is unknown (a few %).
